description: This file contains functions and classes for consolidating sharded safetensors files, including metadata parsing, memory-mapped data reading, and parallel processing for distributed environments. It is part of the torch.distributed checkpoint utilities, specifically for handling safetensors file consolidation.

classes.name: _FqnData
classes.description: Stores metadata about a tensor identified by its fully qualified name, including offset, shape, dtype size, and dtype string.

classes.name: _OutputFileData
classes.description: Stores metadata about an output safetensors file, including metadata size and a mapping of tensor names to their metadata.

classes.name: _InputFileData
classes.description: Stores metadata about an input safetensors file, including metadata size and the metadata content.

methods.name: _parse_input_metadata
methods.description: Analyzes input safetensors metadata to determine full tensor shapes and types, updating output file metadata accordingly.

methods.name: _write_metadata
methods.description: Writes metadata headers to output safetensors files, including tensor shapes, data types, and offsets.

methods.name: _read_tensor_data_mmap
methods.description: Reads tensor data from a safetensors file using memory mapping for efficiency.

methods.name: _process_output_file
methods.description: Processes a single output file by writing tensor data from input files, using memory mapping and handling sharding.

methods.name: _write_data
methods.description: Coordinates writing tensor data from input files to output files, optionally using multiple threads.

methods.name: _write_sub_tensor_to_file_optimized
methods.description: Efficiently writes contiguous chunks of tensor data into the full tensor buffer, handling various sharding patterns.

methods.name: _calculate_max_contiguous_elements
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of contiguous elements that can be written from a current position, considering tensor layout and sharding.

methods.name: _write_overall_metadata_file
methods.description: Creates a JSON index file mapping tensor names to their file locations and total size.

methods.name: _consolidate_safetensors_files
methods.description: Main function that consolidates sharded safetensors files into output files, handling metadata parsing, writing, and data copying.

methods.name: consolidate_safetensors_files
methods.description: Public API to perform the entire safetensors file consolidation process, including setup, metadata, and data writing.

methods.name: consolidate_safetensors_files_on_every_rank
methods.description: Distributed version of the consolidation process, dividing work across ranks and merging results.
